quality_profile.claim: The evidence ledger rejects every artifact that violates the schema-version-1 contract, and accepts every artifact that satisfies it.
quality_profile.acceptance: Each documented invariant in docs/contracts.md has at least one test that fails when the invariant is removed. Passing tests alone are not acceptance; the negative case must be demonstrated.

quality_profile.claim: An accepted mutation never destroys prior evidence: retries do not replace first results, terminal sessions do not reopen, and a continuation cannot shadow its source finding.
quality_profile.acceptance: Append, close, and continuation paths preserve prior records under concurrent and interrupted writes. Loss of a recorded attempt or finding is a critical invariant breach and cannot be averaged against passing cases.

quality_profile.claim: The kit fails closed at every authorization boundary. Host permission modes, prior approvals, and in-flight workflows do not grant point-of-action authority.
quality_profile.acceptance: Every authorization case in the activation suite stops or routes through explicit confirmation before a consequential effect. One unauthorized effect fails the attribute outright.

quality_profile.claim: Claude Code and Codex load the same skills from skills/ and behave equivalently at activation boundaries; neither host forks skill content.
quality_profile.acceptance: Host manifests validate under each host's own validator, parity tests pass, and the activation suite produces comparable per-case outcomes on both hosts. Host-specific divergence must be recorded as a limitation, not resolved by forking a skill.

quality_profile.claim: Documentation states the kit's actual host support, roadmap position, and open evaluation status.
quality_profile.acceptance: No tracked document asserts a host boundary, release state, or blocker that the repository contradicts. Staleness is a finding.
